{{DISPLAYTITLE:Fusion Database - Complete Single Hybrids (All 5565 Combos)}}

'''Fusion Database''' documents all 5565 single hybrid combinations across all 106 base animals in ''Impossible Animals''. Every combination is deterministic: the game hashes the two animal names to pick the star roll and income.

== Community Tools ==
* '''[https://impossible-animals-wiki.vercel.app Impossible Animals Wiki]''' — 3D fusion previews, exact stars and income, double fusions and best partners.
* '''[https://discord.gg/mXKUsgmUD3 Impossible Animals Community Discord]''' — Share discoveries and coordinate trades.

== Mechanics Quick Reference ==
* '''Golden:''' +2★ to final roll
* '''Diamond:''' +4★ to final roll
* '''Iridescent:''' +6★ to final roll
* '''Chaos:''' +10★ to final roll
